sources.title: himemori_luna_(1st_costume)
sources.excerpt:
The default costume of [[hololive]]'s [[Himemori Luna]].

It consists of a [[crown]], [[crescent earrings]], a [[short dress|short]] [[pink dress|pink]] [[frilled dress|frilled]] [[off-shoulder dress]] with a [[detached collar]] decorated with a [[crescent necklace]], [[puffy short sleeves]] and a [[large bow|large]] [[back bow]], a [[pink skirt|dark pink]]/[[purple skirt|purple]] [[miniskirt]] with a [[petticoat]], gold [[bracelet]]s, [[pink bloomers|pink]] [[bloomers]], [[frilled thighhighs|frilled]] [[purple thighhighs]] with a [[mismatched legwear|different pattern each]] ([[vertical-striped thighhighs|vertical stripes]] on her right leg and a [[starry sky print|starry sky]] [[print thighhighs|print]] on the other) and [[blue footwear|blue]] [[pumps]] with candy-shaped [[footwear bow|bows]].

h4. Appearance

* !post #3727890: Profile
* !post #4019385: Reference sheet
* !post #5072370: Live2D
